entities.summary: José Victorino Lastarria was a Chilean writer, legislative deputy, senator, diplomat, and finance minister. He was a liberal associated with the opposition to the consecutive governments of Joaquín Prieto (1831–1841), Manuel Bulnes (1841–1851), and Manuel Montt (1851–1861). José Victorino Lastarria was a journalists & chroniclers from Rancagua (1817-03-23, Rancagua–1888-06-14). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
